import os, subprocess, shutil
from pathlib import Path

source=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/stall-dedupe-20261007")
branch="feat/stall-issue-dedupe-20261007"
expected="db7df56b569202c249f406c39df48b637ec8c8c8"

def run(cwd,args,check=True,env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

# Preserve original authority exactly; only untracked project config may be present.
if run(source,["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()!="main":
    raise SystemExit("source not on main")
if run(source,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()!=expected:
    raise SystemExit("source head changed")
tracked=[x for x in run(source,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.splitlines() if not x.startswith("?? ")]
if tracked:
    raise SystemExit(f"source tracked dirty: {tracked}")

run(source,["git","fetch","origin","main"])
if run(source,["git","rev-parse","origin/main"]).stdout.strip()!=expected:
    raise SystemExit("origin/main changed")

if wt.exists():
    raise SystemExit("target worktree already exists")
run(source,["git","worktree","add","-b",branch,str(wt),expected])

p=wt/"src/do_again/service/liveness.py"
text=p.read_text()
old='''["gh", "issue", "list", "--repo", repository, "--state", "open", "--limit", "100", "--search", f"{title} in:title", "--json", "number,title"],'''
new='''["gh", "issue", "list", "--repo", repository, "--state", "open", "--limit", "1000", "--json", "number,title"],'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("liveness lookup anchor not found")
p.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1))

tp=wt/"tests/test_liveness.py"
t=tp.read_text()
anchor='''        self.assertEqual(result["issue_report"], "existing")
        run.assert_called_once()
'''
replacement='''        self.assertEqual(result["issue_report"], "existing")
        run.assert_called_once()
        argv = run.call_args.args[0]
        self.assertNotIn("--search", argv)
        self.assertIn("--limit", argv)
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("--limit") + 1], "1000")
'''
if anchor not in t:
    raise SystemExit("test anchor not found")
tp.write_text(t.replace(anchor,replacement,1))

# Add a restart-style regression: first call creates, fresh state immediately lists it.
insert='''    def test_issue_reporting_restart_dedupes_without_search_index(self):
        config = {"report_stalls": True, "issue_repo": "Tran-Steven/do-again"}
        empty = Mock(returncode=0, stdout="[]")
        created = Mock(returncode=0, stdout="https://github.com/Tran-Steven/do-again/issues/19\\n")
        visible = Mock(returncode=0, stdout=json.dumps([
            {"number": 19, "title": "[do-again] No-progress after bounded continuation (repo)"}
        ]))
        with patch.object(liveness.subprocess, "run", side_effect=[empty, created, visible]) as run:
            first = liveness._report_stall(self.repo, config, {})
            second = liveness._report_stall(self.repo, config, {})
        self.assertEqual(first["issue_report"], "created")
        self.assertEqual(first["issue_number"], 19)
        self.assertEqual(second["issue_report"], "existing")
        self.assertEqual(second["issue_number"], 19)
        self.assertNotIn("--search", run.call_args.args[0])

'''
marker='''    def test_issue_reporting_creates_sanitized_issue_once(self):
'''
if marker not in t:
    raise SystemExit("insert marker missing")
tp.write_text(t.replace(marker,insert+marker,1))

env=os.environ.copy(); env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
focused=run(wt,["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_liveness"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== focused stderr ==="); print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode: raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

full=run(wt,["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== full stderr tail ==="); print("\n".join(full.stderr.splitlines()[-30:]))
print("full_rc="+str(full.returncode))
if full.returncode: raise SystemExit(full.returncode)

dc=run(wt,["git","diff","--check"],check=False)
print("diff_check_rc="+str(dc.returncode)); print(dc.stdout); print(dc.stderr)
if dc.returncode: raise SystemExit(dc.returncode)

run(wt,["git","add","src/do_again/service/liveness.py","tests/test_liveness.py"])
commit=run(wt,["git","commit","-m","Deduplicate stall issues without search indexing"],check=False)
print(commit.stdout); print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode: raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)
print("head="+run(wt,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status="+repr(run(wt,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
